Docket 1.3.91

**Documentation sites, read properly.**

- *"Your brand name appears 2 different ways" because of a pagination button.*
  A disabled "Previous Page" button — a link with nowhere to go — was taken for
  the logo. A link with no address is no longer read as a link, and a logo that
  links to a language home such as /en is recognised as the link home on the
  pages beneath it.
- *"Getting started with …" pages reported as competing.* "Getting started"
  says what kind of page it is, like "introduction", and a documentation site
  has one for every product. Two of them about different things are no longer
  grouped.
- *Your own name, with an apostrophe, counted as a shared topic.* Your
  business name is set aside before pages are compared — and now it is when
  written with 's too.
- *Colour groups that belong to different themes.* The advice on
  near-identical colours now says that a colour tuned separately for dark mode
  or high contrast is deliberate, like the steps of a shade ramp.

99 checks across 13 areas.
